prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Do you consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please tell me where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving through Conroe, Texas, on a weekday afternoon. I had stopped at a light on the main road heading toward the shopping area.

Q: What happened next?

A: The light was red and I was fully stopped. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I was looking at the light and I never saw it coming in the mirror in time.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, but I was dizzy and my neck and head hurt. I sat on the curb for a while before anyone asked if I was okay.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to the emergency room that evening. They told me I have a concussion. I have headaches, I'm sensitive to light, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Are you currently following your doctor's recommendations?

A: I am. I'm resting as much as I can, avoiding screens when possible, and I have a follow-up appointment next week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my vehicle repaired and my medical bills taken care of. I'm still having symptoms, so I'm not sure how long recovery will take.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.
